title: Explainable Loan Rule Engine with Counterfactual Advice
description: Applies transparent eligibility rules to applicants and, for rejections, computes the smallest change that would flip the decision, checking that advice is actionable and does not require impossible changes.

title: Monte Carlo Tree Search Player for Connect Four
description: Implements tree search with random playouts, tests how playout count changes strength against a fixed opponent and plots win rates with confidence intervals across many games.
